findings.location: Primary navigation menu and site structure
findings.evidence: Navigation menu contains 2 links (/plan, /accessibility); footer contains only policy links (/privacy, /terms). No search form, sitemap link, breadcrumb trail, or related-links list present.
findings.violation: Page offers only one independent navigation mechanism for locating content within the site; content pages require at least two independent mechanisms unless part of a linear process
findings.fix: Add a second independent navigation mechanism such as a site search form, a sitemap link, or a breadcrumb trail to provide multiple ways for readers to locate this page from other pages in the site

findings.location: Form section, promo code input field
findings.evidence: Input element line 67: . Error text line 68: Enter a 6 character code using letters and numbers only.. Input lacks aria-describedby attribute.
findings.violation: Invalid input field marked with aria-invalid="true" but error text is not programmatically associated; input element has no aria-describedby attribute linking to the error message
findings.fix: Add aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" attribute to the promo input element to programmatically associate the error message so screen reader users hear it when navigating to the field
